name: Inma no Tanima
source:
There are rumors from a neighboring village about a succubus cum-squeezing men to death.
Hearing this, a lone hero sets out to deal with the matter.
This sex demon should be no match for the legendary hero.
However, before she is defeated, she begs for her life in exchange for a titjob...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE296576.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
邻村传来消息，据说有一名魅魔会将男人榨干精液，直至死亡。
听闻此事，一位独行的勇者动身前去解决问题。
对传说中的勇者而言，这只淫魔本应不足为惧。
然而，就在她即将被击败时，却提出以一次乳交，换取饶命……
